description: Awin Advertiser MasterTag on www.dwin1.com/{advertiserId}.js. Conversion pixels on www.awin1.com are vendor/awin.

params.name: advertiser_id
params.description: It is the numeric Awin advertiser ID, also called the program MID. Awin documents the MasterTag as `www.dwin1.com/{advertiserId}.js`.
params.fix_hint: Replace `{advertiserId}` with the Advertiser ID from the Awin UI, such as `1001.js`.
